professional_consensus._note: No professional reviews found from any pool. TheWindowDog, Jay Johnson, GBA, FHB, JLC — no specific 250 Series DH evaluations found. LOW_CONFIDENCE flag should be applied.

component_quality._note: Standard vinyl frame construction with multi-chamber design. Warm-edge spacer documented but specific type undisclosed. Compression seal system basic.

repairability._note: Pella maintains 200+ showrooms across North America. Standard IGU replacement through dealer network.

thermal.note: NFRC certified, Energy Star qualified across multiple climate zones. Vinyl frame — higher conductivity than wood/fiberglass. No specific DH U-Factor published by manufacturer. Third-party sources cite 0.30 U-factor which aligns with Energy Star Northern zone floor. NFRC database confirms U-Factor 0.30 for air-fill dual-pane, 0.26 for argon-fill.

structural.note: AAMA Certified R-PG20 to R-PG50 range (FPAS#: FL 26534). Standard DH configuration typically falls in R-PG25 to R-PG35 range. Midpoint 5.5 is appropriate for standard configuration without specific DH test data published.

air_water.note: Pella does NOT publish air infiltration value for DH configuration. NFRC database has no air leakage entry for Pella 250 Series. Third-party comparison sites cite '0.10 AI' but this is unverified — source may be extrapolating from AAMA test data, casement configs, or other product lines. Energy Star certified = ≤0.30 cfm/ft² minimum met. Scored at cert floor + small uplift (5.5) given Energy Star status and triple weatherstrip system. If Pella or AAMA publishes a specific DH air infiltration value, update evidence_level to PUBLISHED and rescore from the table (0.10 → 10, 0.11-0.13 → 9, etc.).
